tokens.name: orb-void
tokens.usage: The black the orb and the mark sit on. Ground of the rail, the voice bar and the cover in both themes.

tokens.name: orb-core
tokens.usage: The orb's body: it absorbs light, so the centre stays this dark. Orb only.

tokens.name: orb-deep
tokens.usage: Where the orb's body meets its shell. Orb only.

tokens.name: orb-copper
tokens.usage: The orb's lit shell and bloom. Orb and gradients only; UI uses `ember`.

tokens.name: orb-peach
tokens.usage: The shell's brightest band and the atmosphere the orb casts. Orb and gradients only.

tokens.name: orb-hot
tokens.usage: The thin incandescent lip and the specular flare. Orb only.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The collapsed rail. Stays black in Daylight too.

tokens.name: rail-ink
tokens.usage: Active rail icons and machine monograms, on `rail`, `rail-hover` and `rail-active`.

tokens.name: rail-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Rail icons at rest, on `rail` and `rail-hover` (5.4:1 and above).

tokens.name: rail-hover
tokens.usage: Rail button under the pointer.

tokens.name: rail-active
tokens.usage: The rail destination that is open.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Window ground behind the inset sidebar and around the canvas.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The inset main panel.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The few things that deserve a surface: the composer, the approval card, inputs, the user's prompt.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, the palette, toasts. In Daylight it relies on shadow-lg.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed: code, terminal output, meter tracks, segmented tracks.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Rows under the pointer.

tokens.name: row-selected
tokens.usage: The open task in the inset sidebar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections and rows. Decorative; a control's edge uses `line-strong`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and switch borders. 3:1 on chrome, canvas, raised and overlay in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and resting icons on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, directory parts of paths, on chrome, canvas, raised, overlay and well (4.5:1 and above).

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The one action colour, copper like the orb: primary buttons, focus, links, running work. As text on every surface and `ember-soft`.

tokens.name: ember-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an ember fill.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind ember text: the running badge.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Needs you: approvals, questions, clarifications. As text on every surface and `attention-soft`.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the approval card header and the needs-you badge.

tokens.name: on-attention
tokens.usage: Count on an attention fill.

tokens.name: voice
tokens.usage: Anything spoken: listening, transcripts, spoken reports, clarify prompts. As text on every surface and `voice-soft`.

tokens.name: voice-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind voice text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed, online, additions. A sage leaning to teal so it separates from danger by more than red and green. As text on every surface and `success-soft`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Added lines, the completed badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, disconnected, deletions, destructive actions. Always with a glyph and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Removed lines, the failed badge.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links; an alias of ember.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Sora carries the wordmark's round geometry. Titles and instrument labels only; never paragraphs.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The command center greeting and the mobile home. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, the task title in its header, card titles in the command center.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Instrument labels: set in uppercase. Section headings in the sidebar, meter captions, the voice bar state.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Onest for everything a person reads or clicks. Its open word spacing survives 12px and React Native, where word-spacing cannot be patched.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and panel headings, toast titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The refresh test raced the clock. I pinned it with a fake timer and it passes 50 runs in a row.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, menu items, task row titles, tabs.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Row metadata, helper text, toast descriptions.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for anything a machine wrote or will read.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, commands in approval cards, inline code in prose.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Terminal output, file paths in work logs, node addresses, keycaps.

spacing.note: 4px base. Rows and controls snap to it; nothing in between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip, glyph to text in a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons and rows; the canvas's inset from the window edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in the inset sidebar and menus; gap between toolbar controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, composer padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between timeline items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Canvas gutter on desktop; gap between command center cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between timeline turns.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between page sections on the canvas.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding under the greeting.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing around the orb on the command center and mobile home.

radius.note: Precise, not bubbly: small controls are nearly square, only presence is round.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keycaps, the diff mini-bar, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, node monograms, rail buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, menus, toasts, the user's prompt block.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The canvas panel, dialogs, the command palette, the voice bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Things that are alive or present: the orb, presence dots, status glyphs.

shadow.note: Surfaces are matte. Glow means something is alive or waiting on you, never decoration.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised cards and the composer at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Anything floating: menus, the command palette, toasts, the voice bar.

tokens.name: glow-ember
tokens.usage: Alive: the running task's glyph, the send button when there is something to send, the primary button on hover.

tokens.name: glow-attention
tokens.usage: Waiting on you: the approval card, the needs-you counter.

tokens.name: glow-voice
tokens.usage: Listening: the mic button and the clarify card while voice is open.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px canvas gap, then 2px of solid ember (7:1 in Void, 6:1 in Daylight). A box-shadow, so it follows the radius.

layout.note: The shell: rail, inset sidebar, canvas.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The collapsed rail. Never resizes.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The inset sidebar's default; resizable from 240px to 400px.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Canvas header and the inset sidebar's header, aligned.

tokens.name: canvas-gap
tokens.usage: Space between the canvas panel and the window's top, right and bottom edges.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Timeline and composer column width.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons in toolbars and rows; small buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Rail buttons, large buttons, the palette's search field.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Menu items and single-line rows; task rows are two lines at 52px.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on mobile.

gradient.note: Two gradients, both the orb's light. Neither is a button or card fill.

tokens.name: gradient-voice
tokens.usage: The listening waveform and the voice bar's bottom line.

tokens.name: gradient-horizon
tokens.usage: The low light the orb casts across the top of the command center and the mobile home. One per screen, always behind the orb.
